notes:
• Finds existing backups in the selected folder and remembers backup locations per project.
• Restores previous audio merge groups and adds Select all / Deselect all.
• Re-backup exports the current In/Out selection to temporary files before replacing old backups.
• Automatic import uses the Align Existing workflow. File-lock retries release unused references, save once, and wait six seconds; Cancel stops retries.
• Removes unused duplicate plugin backup items while preserving items used by sequences and unrelated media.
• Clearer sequence titles, smaller organized dialog details, and fewer repeated refresh checks.
• Save your project and restart Premiere after updating.
